Class Game

java.lang.Object
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.Game
public final class Game extends Object
Central singleton representing the entire Tower Defence game.

Singleton pattern: only one Game instance exists. The constructor is private and all access goes through getInstance().

Abstract Factory: an EntityFactory is injected via start(EntityFactory, ConfigManager). The game package only knows the interface; the J2D package provides the concrete J2dEntityFactory. The factory also provides the GameView (render + input abstraction), keeping the game package completely free of visualization imports.

Role: the game singleton owns all entity lists (towers, enemies, projectiles, base), tracks score and gold, holds the current GameState, runs the main game loop via start(EntityFactory, ConfigManager), and handles player input (pause, tower placement, restart).

Game loop (inside start → update(double)): spawn enemies via the WaveManager, update enemies (move + slow timer), check enemies reaching the base, update towers (cooldown tick), apply tower area effects (ice slow), do tower targeting + firing, update projectiles, check projectile↔enemy collisions + splash, clean up dead enemies (awarding gold/score), clean up dead projectiles, and finally run the win/lose check.

    • start

      public void start(EntityFactory factory, ConfigManager config)
      Sets up and runs the game. This is the only method Main needs to call.

      It stores the factory and config, obtains the GameView from the factory (render + input), shows the title screen (GameState.MENU — a level is only loaded once the player presses S, see handleInput()), and then runs the game loop: input → update → render → sleep.

      The factory provides both entity creation and the visualization layer via EntityFactory.getView(), so Game never imports any J2D classes. This method does not return — it loops until the window is closed.

      Parameters:
      factory - the abstract factory used to create entities and the view
      config - the loaded game configuration

    • update

      public void update(double deltaTime)
      Advances the whole game world by one frame. Does nothing unless the state is GameState.PLAYING.

      Runs, in order: enemy spawning, enemy movement and Lua AI, base-reached checks, tower cooldowns and area effects, tower targeting/firing, projectile movement and collisions (including splash), cleanup of dead enemies (awarding gold/score) and projectiles, the ECS floating-text update, and the win/lose check.

      Parameters:
      deltaTime - the elapsed time since the previous frame, in seconds
